title: Working out parts with Celestin and other leaders
summary: Ridgley says arrangements came from meetings among the men, as players sometimes improvised better than the leader. Buddy B.T. and Mutt Carey would find a part for each man.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: You see, your partner's name was Papa Celestin. Celestin. Oh. When you worked out these pieces together, who would kind of tell you what to do? Would you be telling them on the music, working out a piece with Celestin?

You see, when we would have those things to do, we would just like to have to have a meeting, or just have to come together. You know, some fellas, if we don't add something to it, like if you'd have something in your mind that you thought would help, I would have something in my mind, but we'd try either, you see. I see.
The leader of the band wouldn't dictate what to do.

I mean… Oh, he couldn't dictate because sometimes you'd have fellas in there on making up those things, improvising, you see, more better than him. But, so before I lead the band, that was his job. Now we had some very good fellas, a fella like Buddy B.T. He had a very good, he had a good talent, a good gift like that. Well, he would always have, even like trombone parts, anything like that.
He'd help you with that? Yeah.
Buddy would help you with that. He'd like Mud Carrot. Them kind that would play their part, and they'd say, you make this.
When they had the melody line, they'd tell the rest of you what they liked, they could hear that you could be doing.

Yeah, you see. I see. Then they'd find a part for each fella, you see, like, a clarinet, you know he's always going to be a, a, a, like that. Well, they'd say, you trombone player, they would take the horn, you see, and they would play their part, and then they would figure a part for you to fit in there with them, you see, and then we would practice that. I see. See? I see. And then you'd do the same thing. That's when you're trying to make up, you know. I knew, right.
